description: Expand Mohist CLI ergonomics for project-scoped work: canonical --project, --output table|json, --body-stdin/--body-file, mo project repo subcommands.

tasks.title: Add ProjectRefOption() and OutputOption() option factories
tasks.description: Introduce two static option-builder helpers in MohistCliCommands.cs: ProjectRefOption() returns the (--project, --project-id) option pair with shared description text, and OutputOption() returns a single --output option with DefaultValueFactory -> 'json'. Existing ProjectIdOption() remains as a thin wrapper for non-issues. The factories are pure builders with no behavior; later tasks wire them into command definitions.
acceptanceCriteria: MohistCliCommands.ProjectRefOption() returns two Option<string?> instances; the first has name 'project' and the second has name 'project-id'
Both options share the same Description text and document --project as canonical and --project-id as a backwards-compatible alias
MohistCliCommands.OutputOption() returns a single Option<string> with DefaultValueFactory returning 'json' and Description listing 'table' and 'json'
Unit tests assert option names, descriptions, and the json default
tasks.notes: Mechanism: returns (Option<string?>, Option<string?>) tuple for the project pair, single Option<string> for output. Helps the next two tasks focus on resolver/renderer behavior.

tasks.title: Refactor ResolveProjectIdAsync to accept (project, projectId) with conflict validation
tasks.description: Change MohistCliApi.ResolveProjectIdAsync from string? explicitProjectId to (string? project, string? projectId). Implement: blank+blank -> fall back to cli-state.json activeProjectId; exactly one non-blank -> use it; both non-blank and identical -> use the single value; both non-blank and different -> print guided error to stderr, do NOT call the server, and return a sentinel the action delegate maps to exit code 1. The same-value / different-value check is a string compare, not a server round-trip.
acceptanceCriteria: ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: 'mohist-local', projectId: null) returns a non-null resolved id
ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: null, projectId: 'proj_abc') returns a non-null resolved id
ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: 'mohist-local', projectId: 'mohist-local') proceeds with the single value (string-equal)
ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: 'mohist-local', projectId: 'proj_other') prints the conflict error mentioning both values and the fix, returns the sentinel, and does not call the HTTP layer
ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: null, projectId: null) with no active project emits the standardized 'no active project' diagnostic and returns the sentinel
ResolveProjectIdAsync(project: 'other-project', projectId: null) when active project is set returns 'other-project' (active project is NOT overridden)
tasks.notes: Sentinel pattern: a nullable tuple result where null means 'failed, action delegate should exit 1' (the action delegate is the only one that calls Environment.Exit / sets exit code).

tasks.title: Add NoActiveProjectMessage helper and replace hard-coded error in Issue.cs
tasks.description: Introduce MohistCliCommands.NoActiveProjectMessage (a constant string) and replace the hard-coded 'No active project. Run ...' string in MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs:43 with a call to it. The new wording is 'Run 'mo project use <name-or-id>' or pass --project <name-or-id>'. The helper is also used by MohistCliApi.ResolveProjectIdAsync (T-002) so all project-scoped commands emit identical wording.
acceptanceCriteria: MohistCliCommands.NoActiveProjectMessage equals 'Run \'mo project use <name-or-id>\' or pass --project <name-or-id>' (or clearly equivalent)
MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs:43 no longer contains a hard-coded 'No active project' string; it references the helper
ResolveProjectIdAsync (from T-002) emits the same NoActiveProjectMessage verbatim when no active project is set
Unit tests assert the exact wording and verify the helper is the single source of truth
tasks.notes: T-003 must follow T-002 because ResolveProjectIdAsync references the same helper; this keeps wording identical across the two code paths.

tasks.title: Add BodyInputResolver static class with mutual-exclusion and file/stdin reads
tasks.description: Introduce internal static class BodyInputResolver in Mohist.Cli with ResolveAsync(string? inlineBody, string? bodyFile, bool bodyStdin, IFileSystem fileSystem, TextReader standardInput, TextWriter error). The method enforces: exactly one source required (zero sources -> 'issue body is required' error, exit code 1, no HTTP); more than one source -> mutual-exclusion error listing the conflicting options, exit code 1, no HTTP; file read uses IFileSystem.ReadAllTextAsync as UTF-8; stdin is drained to EOF. Resolution must happen before the create/update request is constructed.
acceptanceCriteria: BodyInputResolver.ResolveAsync(body: 'x', file: null, stdin: false) returns 'x'
BodyInputResolver.ResolveAsync(body: null, file: 'body.md', stdin: false) with a fake IFileSystem containing 'body.md' returns the file contents
BodyInputResolver.ResolveAsync(body: null, file: null, stdin: true) with a fake TextReader returns the drained stream contents
Zero sources -> writes 'issue body is required' to error and returns a Failure result (no HTTP allowed)
Two or three sources -> writes a mutual-exclusion error naming the conflicting options to error and returns a Failure result
File does not exist -> writes 'could not read body file: ...' to error and returns a Failure result
Unit tests use FakeFileSystem and a fake TextReader (no real I/O) and assert the Failure result type
tasks.notes: Static class with a Result record (Success(string body) | Failure(string message)) so callers can short-circuit before constructing the request.

tasks.title: Add OutputOption validation and PrintWithOutputAsync dispatch
tasks.description: Add MohistCliApi.ValidateOutputMode(string?) that returns the canonical 'json' or 'table' or throws/writes an error listing accepted values. Add MohistCliApi.PrintWithOutputAsync(path, mode, httpContext) that fetches the response, then dispatches to PrintResponseAsync for json or RenderTableAsync for table. Unknown values fail pre-flight (no HTTP call) via the same validation. The json path is byte-identical to the existing PrintResponseAsync output.
acceptanceCriteria: ValidateOutputMode(null) returns 'json'
ValidateOutputMode('json') returns 'json'
ValidateOutputMode('table') returns 'table'
ValidateOutputMode('yaml') writes a validation error listing 'table' and 'json' and returns a Failure result (no HTTP call)
PrintWithOutputAsync with mode 'json' prints the same data payload as the existing PrintResponseAsync
Unit tests use RecordingHttpHandler to assert that the same HTTP request is sent for both modes
tasks.notes: RenderTableAsync is its own task (T-006); T-005 stubs the table dispatch and adds the json equivalence assertion first.

tasks.title: Add RenderTableAsync table renderer for the seven table shapes
tasks.description: Add MohistCliApi.RenderTableAsync(JsonNode? data, TableShape shape) with TableShape enum: ProjectList, ProjectShow, IssueList, IssueShow, WorkflowStatus, Sessions, RepoList. Column accessors are co-located in one file. Long text fields truncate to a soft cap (60 chars title/body, 24 chars id-like) with single-line ellipsis. Active project is marked with '*' in ProjectList when cli-state.json's activeProjectId matches. The HTTP request and response body are identical to the json path: one server round-trip per command regardless of mode.
acceptanceCriteria: ProjectList table contains columns id, name, base branch and marks the active project with '*' when applicable
ProjectShow table is a multi-line summary including id, name, base branch, repository count, created/updated time
IssueList table contains columns number, title, stage, status, priority and truncates long titles
IssueShow table is a multi-line summary with number, title, stage, status, priority, project, updated time, and a condensed body (not a full Markdown dump)
WorkflowStatus table summarizes current stage, task states, and waiting reasons
Sessions table lists session id, state, started, and model
RepoList table lists repository name, path, remote, base branch, and an isDefault marker
RecordingHttpHandler tests assert that table and json paths issue the same HTTP request (method, path, body) and that the rendered table contains at least one representative cell per shape
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliApi.cs (TableShape enum + RenderTableAsync) and unit tests
tasks.notes: Hard cap 60/24 per design D5. No color. Plain text only.

tasks.title: Apply ProjectRefOption + OutputOption to issue list/show/sessions/workflow status subcommands
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs, replace ProjectIdOption() with ProjectRefOption() on BuildList, BuildShow, BuildSessions, and BuildWorkflow (status subcommand). Add OutputOption() to all four. Each action delegate calls ValidateOutputMode + PrintWithOutputAsync. The 'no active project' diagnostic in BuildShow is replaced with the helper from T-003. BuildWorkflow status path is wired to PrintWithOutputAsync so --output works there too.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue list --help lists --project, --project-id, and --output (default json)
mo issue show --help lists --project, --project-id, and --output (default json)
mo issue sessions --help lists --project, --project-id, and --output (default json)
mo issue workflow status --help lists --project, --project-id, and --output (default json)
mo issue show 83 --project mohist-local sends GET /api/projects/mohist-local/issues/83 (or equivalent path through ProjectResolutionEndpointFilter)
mo issue list --output table renders the IssueList table; --output json matches the no-flag JSON output
Backwards compatibility: mo issue show 83 --project-id <id> still works and resolves through the same helper
tasks.notes: These four are the commands that need --output per the spec; --project is added uniformly because the same ProjectRefOption helper is used everywhere.

tasks.title: Apply ProjectRefOption to remaining issue subcommands (create/update/start/approve/reject/close/reopen/retry/rerun/force-stop/resume/rebase/archive/unarchive/logs/events/diff/commits/workflow timeline)
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs, replace ProjectIdOption() with ProjectRefOption() on the remaining 18+ project-scoped subcommands listed in cli-project-ref spec. None of these gain --output. The 'no active project' diagnostic is updated to use the helper. Each action delegate's project resolution is routed through the new ResolveProjectIdAsync (project, projectId) overload.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue create --help lists --project and --project-id (no --output)
mo issue update --help lists --project and --project-id (no --output)

mo issue start --help, mo issue approve --help, mo issue reject --help, mo issue close --help, mo issue reopen --help, mo issue retry --help, mo issue rerun --help, mo issue force-stop --help, mo issue resume --help, mo issue rebase --help, mo issue archive --help, mo issue unarchive --help, mo issue logs --help, mo issue events --help, mo issue diff --help, mo issue commits --help, mo issue workflow timeline --help all list --project and --project-id
mo issue close 83 --project mohist-local sends the close request to the resolved project route
Backwards compatibility: existing --project-id scripts continue to work unchanged
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (mechanical ProjectIdOption -> ProjectRefOption replacements) and integration tests covering a representative sample
tasks.notes: Mechanical change at each site. Representative sample of 3-4 subcommands in integration tests; full surface covered by the unit-level option-name tests.

tasks.title: Wire --body, --body-file, --body-stdin into BuildCreate and BuildUpdate via BodyInputResolver
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs BuildCreate and BuildUpdate, register --body (existing), --body-file <path>, and --body-stdin options. Mutual exclusion is documented in help text. The action delegate calls BodyInputResolver.ResolveAsync before constructing the create/update payload. The resolved text is sent as the body field; the CLI does not log it in normal mode.
acceptanceCriteria: mo issue create --help lists --body, --body-file, --body-stdin and notes mutual exclusion
mo issue update --help lists --body, --body-file, --body-stdin and notes mutual exclusion
mo issue create 'Title' --body 'literal' sends the literal body unchanged
mo issue create 'Title' --body-file body.md (with body.md present) reads the file and sends its contents
mo issue create 'Title' --body-stdin with piped stdin drains stdin and sends the contents
mo issue create 'Title' (no body option) writes 'issue body is required' to stderr and exits non-zero with no HTTP call
mo issue create 'Title' --body 'a' --body-file b.md writes a mutual-exclusion error mentioning the conflicting options and exits non-zero with no HTTP call
mo issue create 'Title' --body-file missing.md writes a file-read error and exits 1 with no HTTP call
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Issue.cs (BuildCreate/BuildUpdate edits) and integration tests using FakeFileSystem + a fake TextReader
tasks.notes: The text 'literal' is sent in the JSON body field; BodyInputResolver is the single source of truth, called once per create/update.

tasks.title: Add mo project repo subcommand group (list/add/set-default/remove)
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Project.cs, add a new BuildRepo() method returning a 'repo' command with four subcommands. list -> GET /api/projects/{ref}/repositories; add --name X [--path Y] [--remote Z] [--base-branch W] [--set-default] -> POST /api/projects/{ref}/repositories with AddRepositoryRequest payload; set-default <name> -> PATCH /api/projects/{ref}/repositories/{name} with { setDefault: true }; remove <name> (alias rm) -> DELETE /api/projects/{ref}/repositories/{name}. Each subcommand uses ProjectRefOption() and routes through ResolveProjectIdAsync. Only list supports --output; add/set-default/remove always print success/failure text. Register BuildRepo under BuildProject so 'mo project --help' lists 'repo'.
acceptanceCriteria: mo project --help lists 'repo' alongside the existing subcommands
mo project repo --help lists list, add, set-default, remove and documents --project <name-or-id> requirement
mo project repo list --project mohist-local sends GET /api/projects/mohist-local/repositories and renders the response (or --output table when specified)
mo project repo add --project mohist-local --name api --path /path --set-default sends POST /api/projects/mohist-local/repositories with the documented payload
mo project repo set-default --project mohist-local api sends PATCH /api/projects/mohist-local/repositories/api with { setDefault: true }
mo project repo remove --project mohist-local api sends DELETE /api/projects/mohist-local/repositories/api
mo project repo add --help does NOT advertise --output; add/set-default/remove always print success/failure text
mo project repo list --project-id <id> resolves through the same helper as --project (backwards-compatible alias)
mo project repo list with no --project and no active project prints the standardized diagnostic and exits non-zero with no HTTP call
tasks.output: packages/cli/Mohist.Cli/MohistCliCommands.Project.cs (BuildRepo method + BuildProject edit) and integration tests
tasks.notes: Reuses PrintGetAsync/PrintPostAsync/PrintPatchAsync/PrintDeleteAsync; the request paths and bodies are verbatim from the design's D7 table.

tasks.title: Apply OutputOption to mo project list and mo project show
tasks.description: In MohistCliCommands.Project.cs, add OutputOption() to BuildList and BuildShow so they accept --output table|json (default json). Each action calls ValidateOutputMode + PrintWithOutputAsync so the table path renders via RenderTableAsync (ProjectList and ProjectShow shapes from T-006) and the json path matches the no-flag JSON output.
acceptanceCriteria: mo project list --help lists --output (default json)
mo project show --help lists --output (default json)
mo project list --output table renders the ProjectList table including id, name, base branch and marks the active project with '*' when set
mo project list --output json matches the no-flag JSON output (request identical)
mo project list --output yaml writes a validation error listing table and json, exits non-zero, makes no HTTP call
tasks.notes: BuildList/BuildShow are project commands and the active project is determined by cli-state.json (not by --project), so --project is not added here per the design's Open Questions.
